package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"text/tabwriter"
	"time"

	"tailscale.com/types/logger"

	"github.com/gamelink-project/gamelink/internal/config"
	"github.com/gamelink-project/gamelink/internal/games"
	"github.com/gamelink-project/gamelink/internal/invite"
	"github.com/gamelink-project/gamelink/internal/security"
	"github.com/gamelink-project/gamelink/internal/transport"
)

var errUsage = errors.New("usage")

type cli struct {
	dir string
	in  io.Reader
	out io.Writer
	err io.Writer
}

func (c *cli) store() *config.AgentStore { return config.NewAgentStore(c.dir) }

func (c *cli) flags(name string) *flag.FlagSet {
	fs := flag.NewFlagSet(name, flag.ContinueOnError)
	fs.SetOutput(c.err)
	return fs
}

func (c *cli) parse(fs *flag.FlagSet, args []string) error {
	if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, flag.ErrHelp) {
			return errUsage
		}
		return errUsage
	}
	return nil
}

func (c *cli) cmdInit(args []string) error {
	fs := c.flags("init")
	if err := c.parse(fs, args); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := c.store().Init(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(c.out, "Initialised %s\n\nNext: expose a game, for example\n  gamelink-agent games add --type minecraft-java\n", c.dir)
	return nil
}

func (c *cli) cmdGames(args []string) error {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(c.err, "usage: gamelink-agent games add|list|remove")
		return errUsage
	}
	switch args[0] {
	case "add":
		return c.gamesAdd(args[1:])
	case "list":
		return c.gamesList(args[1:])
	case "remove":
		return c.gamesRemove(args[1:])
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(c.err, "unknown games command %q\n", args[0])
	return errUsage
}

func (c *cli) gamesAdd(args []string) error {
	fs := c.flags("games add")
	typ := fs.String("type", "", "game type: minecraft-java, minecraft-bedrock, factorio or custom (required)")
	id := fs.String("id", "", "short identifier (default: derived from the name)")
	name := fs.String("name", "", "display name shown to friends (default: the game type's name)")
	desc := fs.String("description", "", "optional short description")
	proto := fs.String("proto", "", "tcp or udp (required for custom games)")
	port := fs.Int("port", 0, "port inside the tunnel (default: the game's standard port)")
	dest := fs.String("dest", "", "where to forward to, as ip:port (default: 127.0.0.1:<port>); use this for Docker or Pterodactyl")
	bridgeEnabled := fs.Bool("console-bridge", false, "enable Bedrock LAN console bridge")
	bedrockIP := fs.String("bedrock-ip", "", "Bedrock server LAN IPv4 address")
	bindIP := fs.String("bridge-bind-ip", "", "agent LAN IPv4 address")
	mediaPorts := fs.String("media-ports", "", "allowed Bedrock media port range, e.g. 19132-19136")
	relayRegion := fs.Int("relay-region", 0, "use this region of the public Tailcat relay map (default: nearest)")
	relayHost := fs.String("relay-host", "", "use your own DERP relay at this host name instead of the public relays")
	if err := c.parse(fs, args); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if *typ == "" {
		return errors.New("--type is required (minecraft-java, minecraft-bedrock, factorio or custom)")
	}
	if err := security.ValidateOptionalPort(*port); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("--port: %w", err)
	}
	var bridge *config.ConsoleBridge
	if *bridgeEnabled {
		parts := strings.Split(*mediaPorts, "-")
		if len(parts) != 2 {
			return errors.New("--media-ports must be a first-last range")
		}
		first, e1 := strconv.ParseUint(parts[0], 10, 16)
		last, e2 := strconv.ParseUint(parts[1], 10, 16)
		if e1 != nil || e2 != nil {
			return errors.New("invalid --media-ports")
		}
		bridge = &config.ConsoleBridge{ServerIP: *bedrockIP, BindIP: *bindIP, MediaPortFirst: uint16(first), MediaPortLast: uint16(last)}
		if err := bridge.Validate(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	} else if *bedrockIP != "" || *bindIP != "" || *mediaPorts != "" {
		return errors.New("bridge options require --console-bridge")
	}
	store := c.store()
	if !store.Exists() {
		return fmt.Errorf("agent is not initialised in %s; run `gamelink-agent init` first", c.dir)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	region, err := transport.ResolveRegion(ctx, transport.RegionSpec{Host: *relayHost, RegionID: *relayRegion})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	g, err := store.AddGame(config.AddGameInput{
		ID: *id, Name: *name, Description: *desc, Type: games.Type(*typ), Protocol: games.Protocol(*proto),
		TunnelPort: uint16(*port), Dest: *dest, Region: region, ConsoleBridge: bridge,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(c.out, "Added game %q (%s)\n  %s port %d in the tunnel -> %s\n  relay: %s\n\n", g.ID, g.Name, g.Protocol, g.TunnelPort, g.Dest, region.RegionName)
	fmt.Fprintf(c.out, "Nobody can reach it yet: no devices are approved. Next:\n  gamelink-agent devices approve --game %s --key nodekey:<friend's key> --label <name>\n  gamelink-agent invite --game %s\n", g.ID, g.ID)
	return nil
}

func (c *cli) gamesList(args []string) error {
	fs := c.flags("games list")
	if err := c.parse(fs, args); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	cfg, err := c.store().Load()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(cfg.Games) == 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(c.out, "No games configured. Add one with: gamelink-agent games add --type minecraft-java")
		return nil
	}
	tw := tabwriter.NewWriter(c.out, 0, 4, 2, ' ', 0)
	fmt.Fprintln(tw, "ID\tNAME\tTYPE\tTUNNEL\tFORWARDS TO\tDEVICES")
	for _, g := range cfg.Games {
		fmt.Fprintf(tw, "%s\t%s\t%s\t%s/%d\t%s\t%d\n", g.ID, g.Name, g.Type, g.Protocol, g.TunnelPort, g.Dest, len(g.Devices))
	}
	return tw.Flush()
}

func (c *cli) gamesRemove(args []string) error {
	fs := c.flags("games remove")
	if err := c.parse(fs, args); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if fs.NArg() != 1 {
		fmt.Fprintln(c.err, "usage: gamelink-agent games remove <id>")
		return errUsage
	}
	if err := c.store().RemoveGame(fs.Arg(0)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(c.out, "Removed %q and deleted its identity. Invitations for it no longer work. A running agent stops serving it within a few seconds.\n", fs.Arg(0))
	return nil
}

func (c *cli) cmdDevices(args []string) error {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(c.err, "usage: gamelink-agent devices approve|revoke|list")
		return errUsage
	}
	switch args[0] {
	case "approve":
		return c.devicesApprove(args[1:])
	case "revoke":
		return c.devicesRevoke(args[1:])
	case "list":
		return c.devicesList(args[1:])
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(c.err, "unknown devices command %q\n", args[0])
	return errUsage
}

func (c *cli) devicesApprove(args []string) error {
	fs := c.flags("devices approve")
	game := fs.String("game", "", "game id (required)")
	pub := fs.String("key", "", "the friend's public key, nodekey:... (required)")
	label := fs.String("label", "", "a name to remember this device by")
	if err := c.parse(fs, args); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if *game == "" || *pub == "" {
		return errors.New("--game and --key are required")
	}
	d, err := c.store().Approve(*game, *pub, *label)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(c.out, "Approved %s for %q", d.PublicKey, *game)
	if d.Label != "" {
		fmt.Fprintf(c.out, " (%s)", d.Label)
	}
	fmt.Fprintln(c.out, ".\nA running agent picks this up within a few seconds. Share the invitation privately: gamelink-agent invite --game "+*game)
	return nil
}

func (c *cli) devicesRevoke(args []string) error {
	fs := c.flags("devices revoke")
	game := fs.String("game", "", "game id (required)")
	pub := fs.String("key", "", "public key to revoke, nodekey:... (required)")
	if err := c.parse(fs, args); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if *game == "" || *pub == "" {
		return errors.New("--game and --key are required")
	}
	if err := c.store().Revoke(*game, *pub); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(c.out, "Revoked. A running agent restarts %q within a few seconds, which ends that device's open sessions and blocks new ones.\n", *game)
	fmt.Fprintln(c.out, "Other approved devices reconnect automatically after the brief restart.")
	return nil
}

func (c *cli) devicesList(args []string) error {
	fs := c.flags("devices list")
	game := fs.String("game", "", "only this game")
	if err := c.parse(fs, args); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	cfg, err := c.store().Load()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tw := tabwriter.NewWriter(c.out, 0, 4, 2, ' ', 0)
	fmt.Fprintln(tw, "GAME\tLABEL\tPUBLIC KEY\tAPPROVED")
	n := 0
	for _, g := range cfg.Games {
		if *game != "" && g.ID != *game {
			continue
		}
		for _, d := range g.Devices {
			fmt.Fprintf(tw, "%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n", g.ID, d.Label, d.PublicKey, d.ApprovedAt.Format("2006-01-02"))
			n++
		}
	}
	if n == 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(c.out, "No approved devices.")
		return nil
	}
	return tw.Flush()
}

func (c *cli) cmdInvite(args []string) error {
	fs := c.flags("invite")
	game := fs.String("game", "", "game id (required)")
	name := fs.String("name", "", "name shown in the friend's GameLink (default: the game's name)")
	note := fs.String("note", "", "optional short note shown on import")
	local := fs.Bool("allow-local-relay", false, "allow a relay on a private IP (for LAN-only test setups)")
	if err := c.parse(fs, args); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if *game == "" {
		return errors.New("--game is required")
	}
	store := c.store()
	cfg, err := store.Load()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	g, ok := cfg.FindGame(*game)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("no game with id %q", *game)
	}
	keys, err := store.LoadKeys(g.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	n := g.Name
	if *name != "" {
		n = *name
	}
	bridgeVersion := 0
	if g.ConsoleBridge != nil {
		bridgeVersion = 1
	}
	s, err := invite.Encode(invite.Invite{
		Name: n, Game: g.Type, Proto: g.Protocol, Port: g.TunnelPort, Addr: string(keys.Addr()), Note: *note, ConsoleBridge: bridgeVersion,
	}, invite.Options{AllowLocalRelay: *local})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Fprintln(c.out, s)
	fmt.Fprintln(c.err, "\nThis invitation is a SECRET: share it privately (direct message), never publicly.")
	fmt.Fprintln(c.err, "It only works for devices you have approved for this game.")
	if len(g.Devices) == 0 {
		fmt.Fprintf(c.err, "Warning: no devices are approved for %q yet, so nobody can connect.\n", g.ID)
	}
	return nil
}

func (c *cli) cmdStatus(args []string) error {
	fs := c.flags("status")
	if err := c.parse(fs, args); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	store := c.store()
	cfg, err := store.Load()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rs, fresh, rerr := transport.ReadRuntime(c.dir)
	if rerr == nil && fresh {
		fmt.Fprintf(c.out, "Agent: running (pid %d, up since %s)\n\n", rs.PID, rs.Started.Local().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
	} else {
		fmt.Fprintln(c.out, "Agent: not running (start it with `gamelink-agent serve`)")
		fmt.Fprintln(c.out)
	}
	state := map[string]transport.GameState{}
	if fresh {
		for _, g := range rs.Games {
			state[g.ID] = g
		}
	}
	if len(cfg.Games) == 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(c.out, "No games configured.")
		return nil
	}
	tw := tabwriter.NewWriter(c.out, 0, 4, 2, ' ', 0)
	fmt.Fprintln(tw, "GAME\tTUNNEL\tFORWARDS TO\tDEVICES\tSTATE\tACTIVE\tACCEPTED\tDENIED")
	for _, g := range cfg.Games {
		st := "not running"
		active, acc, den := "-", "-", "-"
		if gs, ok := state[g.ID]; ok {
			st = gs.State
			if gs.Detail != "" {
				st += " (" + gs.Detail + ")"
			}
			active, acc, den = fmt.Sprint(gs.Stats.Active), fmt.Sprint(gs.Stats.Accepted), fmt.Sprint(gs.Stats.Denied)
		} else if len(g.Devices) == 0 {
			st = "inactive (no approved devices)"
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(tw, "%s\t%s/%d\t%s\t%d\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n", g.ID, g.Protocol, g.TunnelPort, g.Dest, len(g.Devices), st, active, acc, den)
	}
	return tw.Flush()
}

func (c *cli) cmdServe(args []string) error {
	fs := c.flags("serve")
	verbose := fs.Bool("verbose", false, "include Tailcat's own (redacted) network log output")
	if err := c.parse(fs, args); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	store := c.store()
	cfg, err := store.Load()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	red := security.NewRedactor()
	for _, g := range cfg.Games {
		if k, err := store.LoadKeys(g.ID); err == nil {
			txt, _ := k.Private.MarshalText()
			psk, _ := k.PSK.MarshalText()
			red.Add(string(txt), string(psk), string(k.Addr()))
		}
	}
	logf := func(format string, args ...any) {
		fmt.Fprintf(c.err, "%s %s\n", time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"), red.Redact(fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)))
	}
	var tclogf logger.Logf
	if *verbose {
		tclogf = func(format string, args ...any) { logf("tailcat: "+format, args...) }
	}
	if len(cfg.Games) == 0 {
		logf("no games configured yet; add one with `gamelink-agent games add`. Waiting for configuration changes.")
	}
	sup := &transport.Supervisor{Store: store, Logf: logf, TailcatLogf: tclogf}

	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	logf("gamelink-agent %s started; configuration in %s", version, c.dir)
	logf("only approved devices can reach a game; games with no approved devices are not served")
	if err := sup.Run(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	logf("shut down cleanly")
	return nil
}
